title: Up Keep Round 3: Reports, Records, Billing, Field Branding And Deeper Color
brands: Up Keep / Smart Upkeep: home maintenance membership app (https://webermanapps.github.io/smart-upkeep/)
Base: white or cream, #0A0A0A ink, square black buttons, Khand/Hind; 2-3 small pops (terracotta = act, lagoon = info, jungle = done, saffron = due soon); no neon, no pastel, not all-beige
builds_on: upkeep-1 top tags clear, system, warm, lively, multi-accent; upkeep-2 top tags clear, system, visual, guided, easy (no upkeep results files in results/)

pairs.ask: Which Swipe Controls?

optionA.label: Black Squares, Colored Press
optionA.desc: Black outline squares that fill with their role color when pressed.

optionB.label: Cream Squares, Colored Words
optionB.desc: Square buttons on cream with each word in its role color.
